text:
ana_partnerships: Heads-up: Aggregator reported ~11% fewer 'seat-minutes' for CloudMarket window 2026-03-15 00:00-08:00 UTC vs our collector. Delta by customer skewed to 3 enterprise accounts.

kevin_recon: Can you paste the snapshot numbers? Need to know if it's missing rows or different aggregation.

ana_partnerships: snapshot: Aggregator_total=214,900 seat-minutes, Shadow_collector=241,200. Missing ~26,300 units. I'll attach sample customer diff in DM.

julia_integrations: We pushed a change Monday that strips leading zeros from entitlement_id for normalization (to dedupe). If partner sends entitlement as '00012345' but aggregator expects '12345' — should be OK. But if partner still embeds leading zeros in the time-bucket key we might be double-grouping.

sam_ingest: Checking the ingest logs for CloudMarket topic now. @devops-bot can you show recent transform failures and last transform version?

devops-bot: transform-version=2026.3.10-12, last_success=1764322800, recent_errors=0, last_msg_ts=1764322805, pipeline-lag=0ms.

kevin_recon: No errors reported. Could this be an off-by-one windowing bug in the hourly->minute rollup? We changed window rounding to floor() in release 2026.3.10. If aggregator uses ceil() they will attribute minutes to next hour.

julia_integrations: Good catch. I pulled an example event from our shadow feed vs aggregator feed for customer ACME_CORP:
```
shadow_event: {"entitlement_id":"12345","timestamp":"2026-03-15T07:59:30Z","minutes":1}
aggregator_event: {"entitlement_id":"0012345","timestamp_bucket":"2026-03-15T08:00:00Z","minutes":1}
```
That buys minutes into different buckets leading to mismatch in that 00:00-08:00 window.

ana_partnerships: ACME had ~8k missing units. Two other enterprise customers show similar patterns. If aggregator time-bucket policy differs we need to align or reconcile across boundary.

kevin_recon: Short-term: we can run a reconciliation that normalizes both sides to UTC minute floor and join on entitlement after zero-trim. I'll run a backfill job that re-buckets aggregator events to our canonical minute and attribute. ETA 2h.

linda_finance: Hold on billing for impacted invoice run? These are enterprise invoices due tomorrow. Recommend invoice-hold for the three accounts until recon completes. Also want an estimated revenue delta.

kevin_recon: Estimated delta after normalization ~+10.9% for the window -> ~$18,400. I'll include confidence band.

julia_integrations: I'll open a tech-ask to CloudMarket ops to confirm their bucketing semantics and ask for raw message timestamps for the window (s3 or their kafka offsets). SLA says they must provide delivery receipts.

sam_ingest: Running backfill job now (job/backfill-rebucket-176432). cmd: `airflow trigger backfill_rebucket --conf '{"window":"2026-03-15T00:00:00Z/2026-03-15T08:00:00Z","source":"aggregator"}'`

devops-bot: backfill job queued id=job-176432-a1. workers_allocated=4. estimated_time=1h20m.

kevin_recon: Also adding a one-time tolerance rule in recon to mark mismatched-minute attribution instead of dropping records. That will avoid miscounts during this exercise.

linda_finance: Thanks. Finance will apply invoice-hold: INVOICE-HOLD-20260315-3. Please tag me with final adjusted numbers before we release holds.

devops-bot: backfill job started at 1764323100. progress=0%

devops-bot: progress update at 1764323300 -> 60% rows processed.

devops-bot: backfill job completed at 1764323400. output: reconciled_aggregator=240,970, shadow=241,200, delta=0.094% (within SLA).

kevin_recon: Backfill shows reconciliation gap closed to <0.1%. I'll produce a runbook for minute-bucket normalization and include transformations.

julia_integrations: I'll send the tech-ask to CloudMarket ops asking them to adopt floor() bucketing for compatibility and provide delivery receipts. Draft sent.

linda_finance: Received delta and confidence. Releasing invoice holds for those 3 accounts. Finance note: adjust invoice metadata with reconciliation-tag=backfill-176432.

ana_partnerships: Great work team. Action items: 1) Julia to confirm CloudMarket bucketing policy and get receipts, 2) Kevin to publish recon-run artifacts and script, 3) Sam to schedule daily shadow vs aggregator diff alert for 7 days. Leave this thread open until receipts confirmed.

kevin_recon: Will upload artifacts to /rdrw/recon/backfills/176432 and ping here.

sam_ingest: Scheduling alert: diff_threshold=0.5% window=24h start=2026-03-16T00:00Z.

ana_partnerships: Closing for now but will reopen if partner-provided receipts disagree. Thanks everyone :rocket:
